title: See overdue orders
summary: Filter overdue orders and see why they are overdue: too many days in the stage or a past due date.

steps.title: Menu → Clinic History → Lab Orders
steps.details: The jobs sent to external labs and the stage each one is in.

steps.title: Overdue only
steps.details: Click it to see only overdue orders. The number shows how many there are. An order is overdue when it goes past its stage’s days, or when the due date passes before it arrives.

steps.title: Open an overdue order
steps.details: In the Status column, days in red mark the delay in the stage. The Overdue label marks a missed due date.

steps.title: Why it is overdue
steps.details: It shows the days in the stage next to the limit. If the due date passed, it says how many days ago.

steps.title: Lab contact
steps.details: The lab’s phones and email, to chase the job.

steps.title: Stage history
steps.details: Every change is recorded: who made it, when, and how long it was in the previous stage.
